title: Best LinkedIn Profile Writers (2026): How to Hire One
description: How to hire a LinkedIn profile writer: what the package should include, what to send, what drives the price and the red flags to avoid.
intro: A LinkedIn profile is often the first thing recruiters, clients and partners check. A profile writer turns your experience into a clear headline, a readable summary and experience sections that match the roles or clients you want. Profiles go wrong when they are filled with buzzwords, exaggerate achievements, or do not match your resume. This guide helps you get a profile that sounds like you.

faq.q: What does a LinkedIn profile writer usually write?
faq.a: Your headline, the About section, experience descriptions and a skills list. Some also advise on your photo, banner and featured section.

faq.q: Should my profile match my resume?
faq.a: Yes, on facts such as dates, titles and employers. The profile can be more personal and conversational, while the resume is tailored for each application.

faq.q: Will the writer update my profile directly?
faq.a: It is safer to receive the text and paste it in yourself. Do not share your LinkedIn password.

faq.q: Can the writer help with keywords?
faq.a: Yes. Recruiters search LinkedIn by skills and job titles. A good writer includes the terms used in roles you want, naturally.

faq.q: Is this useful for freelancers and business owners?
faq.a: Yes. The profile can focus on the clients you serve and the problems you solve, instead of job hunting.
